wto_idb_cts.reason: WTO IDB/CTS requires a pinned portal export or registered API subscription. Place the source-native CSV under a local path and run: python3 scripts/extract.py --source wto_idb_cts --input /path/to/export.csv

global_trade_alert.reason: GTA data-center/API access is subject to non-commercial/license terms. Obtain an authorized export and run the explicit --input command documented in README.md.

eui_covid.reason: The official EUI project page is a release archive, but a stable current machine-readable file URL was not pinned. Obtain the release file from the project page and run the explicit --input command documented in README.md.

macmap_covid.reason: MACMap COVID tracker is interactive and download access depends on registration/account tier. Obtain an authorized export and run the explicit --input command documented in README.md.

us_hts.reason: US HTS historical annual workbooks are release-dependent. Pin the required 2012-2022 annual files from the official USITC portal, convert/export to CSV, then run the explicit --input command documented in README.md.
